svg.title: How DocWiki works
svg.desc: Documents (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, e-mail, scans, transcripts) land in Blob raw/. Event Grid, the Librarian agent or the reconcile schedule enqueue a wake-up; an Azure Container Apps Job runs 13 stages with Microsoft Foundry models and quality gates, then publishes an immutable release (wiki, evidence sidecars, catalog, search index, agent kit) behind an atomic pointer. Humans browse a Quartz site; Foundry agents use the MCP server with their own Entra identities; local coding agents use stdio MCP and Agent Skills.
svg.text: Compile once, cite every claim, serve humans and agents from one validated release.
Blob raw/ or a local folder
a blob lease keeps it single
Azure Container Apps Job · docwiki worker
model call: structured output, no tools
releases/<id>/ in Blob or a folder
